scores.notes: Both show the same setting of flat-roofed tan limestone buildings, low dry-stone walls, olive trees, and terraced rolling hills in daylight, shifting from the approach road with the house in the distance on the left to the courtyard right in front of the house on the right.

David (standing by the brook on the left and kneeling to be anointed on the right) is recognisably the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short curly dark hair, fair-tan complexion, and slender build.

Moses (seated on the rock on the left and walking at the front of the crowd on the right) is the same elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard, and matching weathered face and build.

Jesus (crouching by the charcoal fire on the left and standing before Lazarus's tomb on the right) matches in age, slender build, olive skin, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, full dark beard, and facial profile.

Jesus (standing in the boat on the left and standing on the water on the right) is the same man in his thirties with shoulder-length brown hair, a neat dark beard, olive complexion, and slender build.

Although both show a white-clothed tea table under an overhanging tree on the left, the house behind the table conflicts in architecture: a wide dark-grey weathered house with tall paired windows and a flat porch roof on the left versus a narrower warm-tan cottage with a steep pitched gable, upper attic window, and peaked porch pediment on the right.

Simon Peter (stepping from the boat on the left and lifting the lame man at the temple gate on the right) is clearly the same stocky middle-aged man with curly salt-and-pepper hair, a full greying beard, and matching weathered facial features.
Jesus (standing in the boat on the left and crouching by the fire on the right) matches in apparent age, build, facial structure, shoulder-length dark hair, and full dark beard.

Alice (standing oversized in the courtroom on the left and drinking from the bottle in the hall on the right) is the same young girl with matching age, fair skin, facial features, build, and long light-brown hair.

Moses (striking the rock on the left and standing on the outcrop overlooking the sea on the right) is the same elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard, and matching profile and build.

Alice (holding the flamingo on the left and drinking from the bottle in the hall on the right) is recognisably the same girl, matching in apparent age, fair skin, face shape, build, and long golden-brown hair.

Both plausibly depict the same circular ashlar-stone lions' den from opposite viewpoints in morning daylight: inside looking up through the circular roof opening at the pale stone-block parapet and wooden hatch on the left, and outside at ground level looking down over the same curved stone-block rim, bolted wooden hatch, and vaulted opening with lions on the right.

The house behind the tea table conflicts clearly in architecture—a brick-and-stone half-timbered house with a bay window on the left versus a pale wooden clapboard cottage with a peaked-gable porch on the right—and the setup also shifts from a bare wooden table under a tree on the right to a white-clothed table under a tree on the left.
David (leaping aside from the spear on the left and kneeling to be anointed on the right) is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, slender build, and matching complexion.

Alice (drinking from the bottle in the dark hallway on the left and crouching oversized in the courtroom on the right) matches in apparent age, fair skin, facial structure, and long wavy golden-brown hair.

Sherlock Holmes (seated on the left in the train carriage and at his desk examining the photograph on the right) is unmistakably the same gaunt, clean-shaven man with swept-back dark hair, receding temples, and sharp aquiline features.

Daniel (standing before Belshazzar on the left and being hoisted up by rope from the pit on the right) is the same older man with short cropped grey hair, a neat short grey beard, matching profile, and slender build.

Simon Peter (leaping from the boat toward the shore on the left and stepping out of the boat onto the dark sea on the right) matches in muscular build, age, rugged profile, curly salt-and-pepper hair, and full greying beard.

While both show a circular grey stone-block pit with lions on a dirt floor, the top architecture conflicts: the left shows an open-topped pit ending at a flat ground-level rim with a flat bolted trapdoor under open misty sky, whereas the right shows a tall enclosed stone cylinder whose walls rise high above a recessed rectangular doorway with double hinged doors where the king looks in.
Jesus (standing before Lazarus's tomb on the left and standing in the boat on the right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, neat dark beard, facial structure, age, and slender build.

Sherlock Holmes (standing on the bed with a match and cane on the left, and examining the photograph at his desk on the right) is clearly the same lean, clean-shaven man with swept-back dark hair, receding temples, and sharp aquiline features.

Both show the same single-masted planked wooden fishing boat on the Sea of Galilee framed by low tan-green hills along the distant shores, with the calmer sea and breaking clouds on the left reflecting the narrative shift from the storm on the right.

Both plausibly show the same pebbly Sea of Galilee shoreline and lake from opposite viewpoints—looking toward the smoking fire on the shore from the boat on the left, and from the shoreline fire looking back toward the boat and distant hills on the right—under matching overcast dawn light.

Simon Peter (standing in the courtyard foreground on the left and leaping from the boat on the right) is the same stocky middle-aged man with curly salt-and-pepper hair, a full greying beard, and matching rugged facial features.

Sherlock Holmes (seated at his desk holding the photograph on the left and kneeling on the bed striking at the snake on the right) is unmistakably the same gaunt, clean-shaven man with swept-back dark hair, high receding temples, and sharp aquiline features.

Sherlock Holmes (examining the photograph at his desk on the left and tapping the pavement in a top hat on the right) matches in lean build, clean-shaven gaunt face, sharp aquiline profile, and dark hair at the sides.

The left image shows the burning white country house and its hedged grounds up close, but the right image is set at Eyford railway station and shows only a distant column of black smoke behind trees on the horizon, leaving too little of the house and its grounds visible to judge.

Simon Peter (stepping over the boat's side on the left and leaping from the fishing boat on the right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with curly salt-and-pepper hair, a full greying beard, weathered skin, and matching rugged face.

Sherlock Holmes (seated on the right in the train carriage on the left panel and standing on the bed on the right panel) is clearly the same gaunt, clean-shaven man with swept-back dark hair, receding temples, and sharp aquiline features.

The house behind the tea table conflicts clearly in architecture—a red-brick house with a rustic timber-truss gable porch and curved-top window on the left versus a pale cream facade with a classical columned pediment portico and rectangular windows on the right—and the setup also changes from a bare wooden table with the tree trunk on the left to a white-clothed table with the tree trunk on the right.

Dr. Watson (standing on the right in Saxe-Coburg Square holding his bag on the left panel, and seated in the armchair on the right panel) is recognisably the same sturdy middle-aged man with a thick dark mustache, clean-shaven chin, square jaw, and matching build.

Both depict the same wide sandy seabed path scattered with stones, shells, and seaweed running between towering foaming blue-green walls of parted sea water toward the distant desert shore in daylight.

Jesus (standing before Lazarus's tomb on the left and standing on the dark sea on the right) has the same shoulder-length dark hair, neat dark beard, apparent age, facial proportions, and slender build.

Both plausibly show the same grassy royal croquet-ground from different angles under matching pale daylight, with similar tufted green lawn, low garden shrubs, and tall deciduous trees along the edges (facing hedges and trees on the left, and facing the low stone perimeter wall and trees on the right).

Alice (standing beside the giant mushroom on the left and drinking from the bottle in the hall on the right) is clearly the same young girl with matching age, fair skin, facial structure, build, and long light-brown hair.
Moses (seated on the rock on the left and striking the rock on the right) is the same elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard, matching weathered face, and slender build.

Dr. Watson (standing in the doorway holding his bowler hat and bag on the left, and seated in the armchair holding the felt hat on the right) is unmistakably the same middle-aged man with parted dark brown hair, a thick dark mustache, square jaw, and sturdy build.

Both plausibly depict the same grassy royal croquet-ground from different viewpoints in matching bright daylight, with similar grassy lawn, dense garden shrubs, and tall deciduous trees framing the grounds (facing hedges and trees on the left, and facing the stone garden wall and trees on the right).

Daniel (standing among the lions on the left and being lifted out of the pit on the right) is clearly the same older man with short cropped grey hair, a neat grey beard, matching facial structure, and slender build.
Jesus (standing in the boat on the left and walking on the water on the right) matches in age, slender build, shoulder-length dark hair, full dark beard, and facial appearance.
Alice (seated at the tea table on the left and standing beside the mushroom on the right) is recognisably the same girl, matching in age, fair skin, face shape, build, and long light-brown hair.

Alice (drinking from the bottle in the dark hallway on the left and leaning beside the mushroom on the right) matches closely in age, fair complexion, facial profile, build, and long wavy golden-brown hair.

The burning house conflicts clearly in size and architecture: a wide five-bay country house with a central roof gable, flat-roofed portico, four chimneys, and bare leafless trees on the left versus a narrower three-bay gable-roofed house with a peaked porch roof, two end chimneys, and leafy green trees on the right.

Simon Peter (standing right of the fire pit in the courtyard on the left and stepping out of the boat on the right) is the same stocky middle-aged man with curly salt-and-pepper hair, a full greying beard, and matching rugged features.

Moses (walking at the front of the crowd on the left and striking the rock on the right) is the same elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard, and matching weathered face and build.

Both depict the same grassy croquet-ground enclosed by a matching low tan brick-and-stone garden wall with stone coping, dense garden shrubs, and tall deciduous trees rising behind it under matching pale daylight.
